extracted.intended_audience: members of the public, regulated entities, state agency staff, attorneys, and others seeking Tennessee administrative rules
extracted.subtask_description: A directory-style page listing Tennessee agencies (by numeric code and name) and stating the official status of the Rules and Regulations of the State of Tennessee as the current, official compilation inclusive of amendments, repeals, and deletions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agency indexing by numeric code and name
rubrics_metrics.description: A sequential listing of state agencies, each given a four-digit (e.g., 0020) code followed by the agency name (e.g., Accountancy). The page enumerates agencies from 0020 Accountancy through 1740 Water and Wastewater Financing Board.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the numeric agency code + agency name pairing to locate, cite, or navigate to the rules for a specific department or board. The listing functions as the table of contents/index for the official compilation of Tennessee rules and regulations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Official compilation status of rules and regulations
rubrics_metrics.description: As provided by T.C.A. Title 4, Chapter 5, the rules and regulations are the current and official rules and regulations presented as the official compilation, Rules and Regulations of the State of Tennessee, and are inclusive of all amendments, repeals, and/or deletions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Treat the compilation on this site as the authoritative, up-to-date source for Tennessee administrative rules; it incorporates amendments and repeals. When relying on or citing a rule, confirm it via this official compilation as it represents the current regulatory status per the cited Tennessee Code Annotated provision.
